name: dsh-collaboration-access
transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over bounded UTF-8 NDJSON; SSH stdio on client, local socket on server
scope: limited ACP-shaped interface with collaboration extensions, not full ACP compatibility

session/load.behavior: attach same session, never replacement or prompt replay

session/cancel.behavior: cancel only active turn, no rollback

connectorOnly.collaboration/connect: signed account ticket over local socket; never forwarded from client

noReplay.requestIdentity: sha256(serviceId NUL account NUL localId NUL messageId)

attachmentExtension.negotiation: clientCapabilities.attachmentTransfer and agentCapabilities.attachmentTransfer exact version 1; missing is text-only, upload never downgrades
attachmentExtension.humanAuthorization: one standalone 附件操作: 上传并归档 or 仅传输 line plus one project_id; current human native refs or explicit workspace files only
attachmentExtension.promptMetadata: _meta.attachments immutable display metadata/opaque handles; no local paths
attachmentExtension.scope: exact current account/session/request capability; all other reverse methods unsupported
attachmentExtension.imageUnderstanding: not enabled; image transport and first-frame validation only

unsupported: native ACP image prompt content (attachments use negotiated handles instead)

errors.-32012: incompatible or missing attachment extension; no upload downgrade

negotiation.policy: required exact match on connector auth, initialize request and response; no aliases/downgrade/replay
